source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Get all the facts. 3. Identify the causes. 4. State the conclusions. 5. Write the recommendations. 6. Double-check conclusions drawn. 7. Make sure it flows and makes sense.

Tips:

1. Use bullets wherever possible when making presentations. 2. Copy the report for the client in a presentable format. 3. Double-check content for technical accuracy. 4. Make sure all the listed items and conclusions are supported by facts. 5. Keep language simple. Example from the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) OSHA issued, on December 13, 2002, a general instruction on the use of its construction noise exposure standards. The instruction establishes national policy and procedures for the enforcement of OSHA’s exposure standards for occupational noise under the Construction Safety and Health Standards, which OSHA issued under the Occupational Safety and Health
